name: Spaghetti Kart [anylinux]
description:
Spaghetti Kart is an enhanced native PC port of the classic Nintendo 64 racing game Mario Kart 64. Built from decompiled code, it delivers smooth high-framerate kart racing natively on Linux.

Features:
- Native PC rendering with high-resolution widescreen and 60 FPS support
- Modern gamepad configuration with analog steering and customizable buttons
- Support for four-player split-screen multiplayer grand prix and battle modes
- Low audio latency with clean digital sound output
- Requires an authentic Mario Kart 64 ROM for game asset generation

This is an unofficial AnyLinux AppImage, which is able to work anywhere including glibc and musl. For more info: https://pkgforge-dev.github.io/Anylinux-AppImages/
